# CANDIDATE: ORB_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A weak opening-range breakout on low volume often reverses, providing a counter-trend entry opposite the breakout direction. This edge exists because low-volume breakouts lack institutional participation and are prone to failure, especially in tight opening ranges (OR width < 0.4% of price) during moderate VIX regimes (12-22), where mean-reversion tendencies are stronger.

## Mechanism

Define the opening range (first 5-minute high and low). If price breaks above the OR high with volume < 0.7× the average 5-minute volume of the session, enter short at the first bar closing back inside the range; if price breaks below the OR low with volume < 0.7× average 5-minute volume, enter long on the first bar closing back inside the range. Exit shape: Chart‑stop placed at the opposite OR extreme (OR low for shorts, OR high for longs); target at VWAP or 1× risk, whichever is hit first. Regime hint: Effective when VIX is moderate (12‑22) and the OR width is less than 0.4% of price, indicating a tight opening range.
